$$t^3 = \frac{n}{8} - t \quad\Longrightarrow\quad t^3 + t = \frac{n}{8}$$

## Step 2: Asymptotics of $t$

$$t = \left(\frac{n}{8}\right)^{1/3}\!\left(1 + \frac{1}{t^2}\right)^{-1/3} = \frac{n^{1/3}}{2}\left(1 - \frac{1}{3t^2} + O(t^{-4})\right)$$

$$\theta^2 = 12x - 112x^2 + \frac{(12x)^2}{3} + O(x^3) = 12x - 64x^2 + O(x^3)$$

Since $t \sim n^{1/3}/2$, we have $n^{1/3}/t \to 2$ and $1/t^2 \to 0$, so:
